---
# Caddie resume template (ADR 0010). `caddie render resume <slug>` copies
# this directory into a temporary one, writes _caddie-body.md (the verified
# draft) and _caddie.json (name, location, email, phone, links) next to it,
# then runs `quarto render resume.qmd --to typst --output <Name>-resume-…pdf`.
# The reader keeps body text literal: no smart quotes, citations, math or
# raw markup.
from: markdown-smart-citations-tex_math_dollars-raw_tex-raw_html-raw_attribute+lists_without_preceding_blankline
format:
  typst:
    shift-heading-level-by: 0
    template-partials:
      - typst-template.typ
      - typst-show.typ
filters:
  - caddie-fields.lua
caddie-layout: resume
---

{{< include _caddie-body.md >}}
